- **`options.unmount`** (hooks/src/index.js:72) now invokes each hook's cleanup in its own try/catch, so one throwing cleanup no longer aborts the remaining ones; the last error is reported via `options._catchError` so error boundaries still receive it and unmounting/DOM removal proceeds normally.
- **`invokeCleanup`** (hooks/src/index.js:351) now clears `hook._cleanup` before invoking it, preventing a cleanup from re-running (and re-throwing) when the unmount pass visits it again.
